propositions: 108 store tickets carry Success Criteria as plain bullets instead of checkboxed Acceptance Criteria items, making them invisible to _count_ac_items counting and plan-review blocking floor validation

Migrating ticket descriptions invalidates plan-review attestations as stale-material, so the migration script must process closed tickets by default and require explicit flags to touch open/in-progress work
The migration must rewrite all Success Criteria blocks into Acceptance Criteria as - [ ] checklist items, merging with existing AC blocks and removing the SC heading entirely
Post-migration verification must confirm zero tickets carry any Success Criteria heading variant, zero migrated tickets fall below the AC floor, and all changes are auditable rebar.edit_ticket events
